[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd app

# The linter reads .lgo files, and the race detector needs two accesses
# to one variable. A goroutine of a Go package that waits on a channel
# nothing else holds gives neither of them a fault.
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./leaks
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '

# The monitor names the statement where the goroutine waits and the
# function that the goroutine runs, while the program still runs.
! logos conc run ./leaks
stdout '^served$'
stdout '^.*legacy[/\\]feed\.go:6: \[conc::goroutine_leak\] a goroutine waits, and no goroutine that can run reaches what it waits for; it never ends$'
stdout '^\t.*feed\.go:6: the goroutine waits here, in runtime\.chanrecv1$'
stdout '^\t.*feed\.go:5: the goroutine runs the function that starts here$'
stdout '^\tfix: '
stdout -count=1 'goroutine_leak'

! logos conc test -count=1 ./leaks
stdout '^ok '
stdout '\[conc::goroutine_leak\]'

# A goroutine that the program can still wake is not a leak.
logos conc run ./stops
stdout '^served$'
! stderr .
! stdout 'conc::'

# The monitor does not keep a deadlocked program alive: the runtime ends
# it with its own error, as in a plain build.
! logos conc run ./stuck
stderr 'all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!'
! stderr 'conc::'
! stdout .

# The test binary of a Go module links the monitor too.
cd ../feeds
! logos conc test -count=1 ./legacy
stdout '^ok '
stdout '^.*legacy[/\\]feed\.go:6: \[conc::goroutine_leak\] '

-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27

require example.com/feeds v0.0.0

replace example.com/feeds => ../feeds
-- feeds/go.mod --
module example.com/feeds

go 1.27
-- feeds/legacy/feed.go --
package legacy

func Subscribe() {
	updates := make(chan int)
	go func() {
		<-updates
	}()
}
-- feeds/legacy/feed_test.go --
package legacy

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestSubscribe(t *testing.T) {
	Subscribe()
	time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
}
-- feeds/tidy/feed.go --
package tidy

func Subscribe() (stop func()) {
	updates := make(chan int)
	go func() {
		<-updates
	}()
	return func() { close(updates) }
}
-- feeds/gate/gate.go --
package gate

var open = make(chan int)

func Pass() {
	<-open
}
-- app/leaks/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"example.com/feeds/legacy"
)

func serve() {
	legacy.Subscribe()
	time.Sleep(800 * time.Millisecond)
}

func main() {
	serve()
	fmt.Println("served")
}
-- app/leaks/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestServe(t *testing.T) {
	serve()
}
-- app/stops/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"example.com/feeds/tidy"
)

func main() {
	stop := tidy.Subscribe()
	time.Sleep(800 * time.Millisecond)
	stop()
	fmt.Println("served")
}
-- app/stuck/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/feeds/gate"
)

func main() {
	gate.Pass()
	fmt.Println("passed")
}
